description: This file defines the 'DishIngredient' result class for the Coocook schema, representing ingredients associated with dishes, including methods for managing purchase list associations and editing.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::DishIngredient
classes.description: A schema result class representing a dish ingredient, including its properties, relationships, and methods for managing purchase list associations and editing.

methods.name: assign_to_purchase_list
methods.description: Associates the dish ingredient with a purchase list by creating or retrieving an item and linking it.

methods.name: update_on_purchase_list
methods.description: Updates the associated purchase list item based on the ingredient's data.

methods.name: remove_from_purchase_list
methods.description: Removes the ingredient from the purchase list, updating or deleting the associated item as needed.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares and returns a data structure suitable for editing the ingredient in an ingredients editor UI, including available units.
